about_the_game:
MAN Lion’s City A26 & A47 – Flexibility and Reliability for Your Fleet

Expand your fleet with the MAN Lion’s City A26 and A47 – two authentically recreated city buses designed perfectly for urban routes. Whether for long lines or compact city routes, these buses provide realistic technology and a detailed driving experience.

Models & Use Cases

  • MAN Lion’s City A26 (14.7 m)
    A long solo bus with high capacity and agility, ideal for heavily frequented lines.

  • MAN Lion’s City A47 (10.5 m)
    A compact solo bus with a vertical engine – perfect for narrow streets and shorter, less busy routes.

Realism at the Highest Level

These buses have been digitally recreated with the utmost attention to detail and authenticity:

  • High-precision 3D model

  • Highly detailed cockpit with functional elements

  • Original sound recordings for engines, doors, and interiors

  • Vehicle physics with realistic inertia, steering, and acceleration

  • Extensive interior detailing

Fully Licensed

The MAN Lion’s City buses were authentically recreated in close collaboration with MAN Truck & Bus and Dr. Richard.

Official liveries, authentic destination displays, and realistic features ensure every ride feels like a real deployment in modern city transport – from the detailed 3D model to full in-game integration.

Technical Data

MAN Lion’s City A26

  • Production Years: 2004 – 2019

  • Length: 14.7 meters (standard bus, not articulated)

  • Width: 2.5 meters

  • Weight: 15.3 tons

  • Engine: Diesel (MAN D2066 LUH), 235 kW / 320 hp

  • Transmission: ZF Ecolife 6-speed automatic

  • Top Speed: 80 km/h

  • Seats: 43 | Standing: 74

  • Special Feature: Steered 3rd axle

MAN Lion’s City A47

  • Production Years: 2004 – 2019

  • Length: 10.5 meters (standard bus)

  • Width: 2.5 meters

  • Weight: 11.2 tons

  • Engine: Diesel (MAN D0836 LOH), 213 kW / 290 hp

  • Transmission: ZF Ecolife 6-speed automatic

  • Top Speed: 80 km/h

  • Seats: 28 | Standing: 33

  • Special Feature: Vertical engine

Play Your Way

Whether you are a hardcore simulation fan or a casual driver, City Transport Simulator: Bus has something for you:

  • Simulation mode with full control over every button and system

  • Easy mode for relaxed driving with helpful tools

  • Keyboard & mouse, full gamepad, and steering wheel support (preconfigured for many wheels)

  • Fully customizable controls, including individual layouts for each input device

Seamless Integration with City Transport Simulator: Tram

City Transport Simulator: Bus is a complete standalone experience built on the same powerful platform as City Transport Simulator: Tram. While each title alone offers a complete public transport simulation, owning both unlocks something even greater.

Experience a connected city where trams and buses run side by side in a shared world. Switch seamlessly between vehicle types, follow coordinated timetables, and manage a linked network through one dynamic menu.

This is more than just another bus simulation – it’s part of a modular simulator system that grows with you.

Built for Long-Term Support

City Transport Simulator: Bus is a deep, customizable public transport simulation, made by enthusiasts for enthusiasts – and it keeps expanding. Ongoing updates, new vehicles, new cities, and more are already planned.

Are you ready to take control of the city?
